text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan was defeated in the Oka Sho. 
Yet she smiled, receiving praise from the 
crowd for her run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Aston Machan gazes 
contentedly at the spectators before 
leaving behind a curious mutter: "This is 
as far as Machan goes..."
